text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Even if I douse myself with water or down 
a cup... it won't calm down... Making me 
feel like this, dammit.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Even through a screen, it gets the blood 
pumping—that world!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I wanna conquer it...! That place... that 
burning heat...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ha, my legs are aching so much I can't 
sleep. —Fine then, I'll conquer it along 
with this heat...!

...And that was how Sirius Symboli ended 
up suffering from a lack of sleep.
